Sync the content-addressable storage index so an object ID maps to the hash of an existing file.
Use when the index is out of sync (e.g. file was renamed to match content hash) and the correct file exists on disk.

Examples:
  # Update index for a single file
  zqk system sync-cas-index --file .zqk/process/backlog_items/<hash>.yaml
  # Preview without writing
  zqk system sync-cas-index --file .zqk/process/backlog_items/<hash>.yaml --dry-run

Usage:
  zqk system sync-cas-index [flags]

Flags:
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --dry-run                 Show what would be done without updating the index
      --file string             Path to the hash-addressed YAML file (e.g. .zqk/process/backlog_items/<hash>.yaml)
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link, raw, md, html) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
